title: Overtone caption document
description: Structure of a .overtone.json file (format version 1): required members, types, closed vocabularies, number ranges and the shape of word ranges. Unknown members are allowed everywhere. Every document that validate() in overtone-format accepts is accepted by this schema, but a document is valid only if validate() also accepts it, because it checks four kinds of semantic rules that this schema leaves out: (1) time precision: at most 3 decimals; (2) order: first <= last in word ranges, end >= start for turns and words, end > start for cues and windows, words in a turn and cues in a profile ordered and non-overlapping, lines in a cue ordered without shared words; (3) uniqueness: speaker ids and profile ids; (4) references: turn and cue speakers declared in speakers, every word of a cue spoken by the cue's speaker, word ranges within the document's words, and line text equal to the referenced words joined by single spaces. See Appendix A of the specification.

time.description: Seconds from the start of the media. At most 3 decimals is checked by validate(), not here: multipleOf 0.001 is unreliable with binary floating point (it rejects 0.823) and cannot apply the specification's rounding tolerance.

wordRange.description: Inclusive [first, last] global word indices. validate() also checks first <= last and that last is less than the number of words.

id.description: Unique among the speakers (checked by validate()).

word.description: validate() also checks end >= start, and start >= the end of the previous word in the turn.

speaker.description: Id of a speaker in speakers (checked by validate()).

cueLine.description: validate() also checks that the range starts after the previous line's range in the cue and that every referenced word belongs to the cue's speaker.

text.description: The referenced words joined by single spaces (checked by validate()).

cue.description: validate() also checks end > start, and start >= the end of the previous cue in the profile.

speaker.description: Id of a speaker in speakers (checked by validate()).

id.description: Unique among the profiles (checked by validate()).

aspect.description: The picture shape the cues are cut for, "W:H".
